title: Cross-team engineering leadership — weekly staff notes (2026-05-11)
content:
Date: 2026-05-11
Meeting: Cross-team engineering leadership — weekly staff
Location: Zoom / hq-prod-gtm room
Owner (notes): Samira Patel
Attendees: Samira Patel, Liam O'Connor, Erin Zhao, Mateo Rivera, Priya Singh, Noah Kim, Aisha Rahman (observability), Carlos Mendes (platform), Jun Park (private-deployments) + others

Agenda:
- Quick metrics and SLO review
- Major incidents / postmortem updates
- Release cadence and May launch readiness
- Capacity & cost: Dedicated autoscaler adjustments
- Private deployment customer onboarding status
- Cross-team blockers and action items

1) Metrics & SLOs (Erin / Aisha)
- 99th p95 latency: stable at 142ms on average for text-gen across hosted API (down slightly week-over-week).
- Token throughput: 18.4B tokens/day (10% increase y/y).
- Error rate: 0.6% overall, spike on 2026-05-09 due to upstream config change (see incident).
- Observability notes: added per-route cost breakdown dashboard; need to tune alert thresholds for queued requests.

2) Incidents / Reliability (Noah)
- Incident summary (2026-05-09): config rollout to autoscaler caused transient capacity misreporting; resulted in ~6 minutes of elevated queue times for dedicated customers.
  - Root cause: race condition in the metrics ingestion job (ENGINF-872).
  - Mitigations deployed: hotfix to metrics job + temporary rollback of autoscaler config.
  - Postmortem ETA: 2026-05-14 (owner: Noah).
- Action: prioritize end-to-end integration test for autoscaler config changes in staging (owner: Mateo, due 2026-05-25).

3) Serving runtime & kernel rollout (Mateo)
- Kernel selection change (v2.8) rolling to 10% of traffic today; initial perf looks good (+8% throughput for long-context workloads).
- Observed behavior: slight increase in memory churn for some 32k-token runs — investigating (owner: Mateo, follow-up by 2026-05-18).
- Canary checklist: add KV-cache warmup metric to canary dashboard; backlog item created.
- Decision: continue 10% -> 30% ramp over next 48h if no regressions.

4) Release cadence & product readiness (Priya)
- May release items: streaming improvements, function-calling refinements, additional model variants for low-cost tier.
- Docs & SDK updates: delivery target 2026-05-15. Need help from devexp for code samples (owner: Erin).
- Product asks: verify deterministic fallback policy works for Dedicated -> Hosted fallback (owner: Carlos, due 2026-05-17).

5) Dedicated / Autoscaling (Carlos)
- Autoscaler tuning: moved to per-pool back-pressure thresholds; expected to reduce oscillations.
- Capacity planning: forecast for June shows 22% increase in committed tokens from top 3 customers — recommend reserving extra burst nodes (finance OK with provisional spend).
- Action: create a short runbook for on-call to force-add capacity during black swan events (owner: Jun, due 2026-05-20).

6) Private deployments & customer onboarding (Jun)
- Two new private deployments in runway: regulated healthcare customer onboarding delayed due to KMS integration audit (expected 2-week delay).
- On-prem package: 0.9.1 build passed internal tests; customer smoke tests scheduled for 2026-05-19.

7) Observability & tracing (Aisha)
- Tracing hooks for model-version rollout implemented; need to surface regressions to quality-monitoring team.
- Action: add automatic regression alert when latency increases >15% for a pinned prompt set (owner: Aisha, due 2026-05-22).

8) Hiring & resourcing (Samira)
- Hiring update: two senior infra hires starting late May; SRE hire pipeline moving to final interviews.
- Temporary reallocation: add one SWE from devexp to help with SDK docs for May release (Erin to coordinate).

9) Cross-team blockers
- Blocker: KV-cache warmup metric missing from canary leads to delayed detection of regressions (owner: Mateo).
- Blocker: KMS audit items blocking healthcare private deployment (owner: Jun).

Decisions made:
- Proceed with kernel v2.8 ramp to 30% in 48h if no regressions observed (owner: Mateo).
- Autoscaler tuning change will stay in place for 2 weeks with close monitoring; revert plan documented (owner: Carlos).

Action items (owner — due):
- Noah — Postmortem for 2026-05-09 autoscaler incident (2026-05-14)
- Mateo — Investigate memory churn on 32k-token runs and add KV-cache warmup metric (2026-05-18 / 2026-05-20)
- Erin — Coordinate SDK/docs code samples for streaming & function-calls (2026-05-15)
- Carlos — Verify Dedicated -> Hosted fallback and update runbook (2026-05-17 / 2026-05-20)
- Jun — Runbook for forcing capacity & KMS audit follow-up (2026-05-20 / 2026-05-25)
- Aisha — Add regression alert on pinned prompt latency (>15%) (2026-05-22)
- Samira — Confirm provisional budget for burst nodes and sync with Finance (2026-05-13)

Notes / parking lot:
- Follow-up: longer term work to reduce token unit cost by 10% via quantization profiles (Optimize team to propose plan by end of Q2).
- Consider a 1:1 deep dive with top 3 committed customers on autoscaling expectations (Sales + Solutions Eng to schedule).

Next meeting: 2026-05-18 (same time).

Quick readouts post-meeting: please add status updates to the linked Confluence page and tag relevant Jira items.

End notes: rough/working doc — will convert to final postmortem + exec summary where appropriate.
